title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide
description: Discover how and where to pre-order the official GTA 6 limited edition PS5 controllers in black and white, launching alongside the game on November 19, 2026.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Your Pre-Order Guide

As the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto VI draws closer, Sony and Rockstar Games have teamed up to give fans a hardware option to match their excitement. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, a new line of limited-edition DualSense controllers themed around GTA 6 has been officially announced, giving players a stylish way to gear up for the upcoming release.

## Design Highlights and Aesthetics

The collaboration brings two distinct colorways for players to choose from: a sleek black version and a clean white version. Both controllers share several striking design elements that evoke the iconic aesthetic associated with the franchise's return to Vice City:
* **Custom Faceplate**: A vibrant blue and purple faceplate surrounds both thumbsticks and the touchpad.
* **Official Branding**: The official GTA 6 logo is prominently printed directly onto the touchpad.
* **Textured Handles**: Both handles feature subtle palm tree indentations, adding a unique tactile feel and a thematic touch of tropical atmosphere.

## Launch Date and Availability

For those looking to secure their hardware in advance, pre-order links are rolling out across the US and UK. 
* **Release Date**: Both the black and white limited-edition controllers are scheduled to launch on the exact same day as the game itself: **19th November 2026**.

## Editor's Take

Hardware collaborations between Sony and blockbuster titles are always a major event, and these GTA 6 controllers hit all the right notes with their subtle blue-and-purple accents and palm tree details. With the game launching on 19th November 2026, grabbing one of these limited controllers is a fantastic way for PlayStation 5 fans to complete their ultimate setup ahead of opening night.
